separate_folds: Historical uses 6,954 earlier passengers including a strict same-order holdout subset. Grouped eight refits three deployable contenders using the exact repaired v108 probabilities, the known v131 sign, and the original blend weights. Both eightfold scopes exclude 161 unresolved parent cases. New orders excludes any order in the historical sample. For the four composite files replay the service, individual and registration models, bound the zero-donor ranking with unresolved parent decisions, and permit both values for the undocumented nested three-way vote. Only rows with a unique resulting decision enter repair/harm counts; all-scope net bounds also include the indeterminate portion. The test distances and aggregate score limits use no passenger labels.
comparisons: Historical scores compared only with nine and eight individually replayed queue branches; filtered and TabNet have no verified same historical query decisions. All ten queue entries are directly compared on exact eightfold evidence for three releases. Distance to a scored CSV is unlabeled and does not estimate the reserve score.
